principles.principle: Zero cash expenditure. Any fee, paid copy, subscription, paywall, postage, licence, travel or court cost triggers PAUSE—NO SPEND; use a free lawful alternative or close the avenue.
Maximum two outbound messages across all institutions and all routes on any calendar day. This is a hard ceiling, not a target.
No new outbound contacts 1–15 January 2027. Use the first two weeks to reconcile live 2026 clocks, replies, attachments, drafts and requester closures.
No blanket first-week FOI. Tier 1 and Tier 2 contacts are staggered and conditional on complete 2026 thread checks.
Use FOI/EIR only where the recipient is subject to the relevant regime; SAR only for personal data; voluntary records/archive enquiry for private recipients.

Internal reviews, reconsiderations, regulator complaints, ombudsmen and elected-representative routes are conditional on eligibility and each institution's published process. Nothing is sent automatically.
Court, tribunal, judicial review, pre-action, litigation and fee-bearing routes are excluded. This is constituent engagement through democratic and administrative channels.
Request text, review grounds and complaint submissions are intentionally populated during 2027 from source evidence, not invented in this calendar.
